sourceOriginChain.materializedFrom: MPFB2 HumanService.create_human with macro_detail_dict derived from the tracked Anny reference
sourceOriginChain.derivationNote: Issue #328: the MPFB2 materializer now derives its macro dict from the tracked Anny reference instead of baking the default human. age=0.6 from the measured head-height fraction (0.100, adult band); height=0.5827 SOLVED by bake-measure-interpolate so the baked+stripped exported body reaches the reference stature (1.76 m). Macros baked into the basis via TargetService.bake_targets immediately after create_human. #317 face keys (32 targets / 13 mouth), #318 helper strip (19,158->13,380 verts / 36,972->26,756 tris), #321 toigo t-shirt fit (2,700 tris, k-NN weighted to the standard rig) and #323 body-part hiding all ran unchanged. Measured (largest non-garment/non-hidden primitive): stature 1.6528 m, chest 0.9484, waist 1.1056, chest:waist ratio 0.8578. Regenerated 2026-08-11 (#337 resume): merged main (#335) and re-baked with CC0 MakeHuman default eyes (data/eyes/hm08/low-poly, header-verified CC0) fitted pre-#318-strip via HumanService.add_mhclo_asset(asset_type="eyes", material_type="PROCEDURAL_EYES"); eye mesh renamed makeclothes_library_eyes_low_poly_mpfb_<body>_mesh (96 verts / 172 tris), weighted 1.0 to eye.L/eye.R by interpolate_weights (dominant groups eye.L 48 / eye.R 48); #334 hide-mask head-joint bound and #335 casts preserved; iris rotation delta at gaze=1 measured 10-13 mm, 89-94% lateral. Issue #340: re-baked with the eye material consuming the asset's OWN declared .mhmat — brown.mhmat's diffuseTexture brown_eye.png (CC0, 610,817 bytes, git blob bda1b4b0 == upstream main) bound as glTF baseColorTexture via the generic make_material_from_mhmat path; the flat eye baseColor (#337 white / #338 brown) is gone. Eye geometry (96 verts / 172 tris, eye.L/eye.R weights) unchanged; body macros, hide masks, garment fits, footwear and sole grounding re-run identically. textureMode updated procedural_fallback -> authored_or_baked because the eye channel now carries a baked diffuse texture. Issue #180 (2026-08-12): re-baked with the #180 palette + scrub wiring — materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py now takes --actor-role and consumes automate_blender.garment_shell_color as-is (locked gown/scrub + closed_casual role fallback; no table copied). Nurse actor: upper garment is the CC-BY makehuman-community-scrub-shirt Scrub_Shirt.mhclo (max ref 11,018 < 13,380, fits the #318 stripped basemesh; ClothesService smoke fit ok, 4,688 verts / 9,384 tris) with the locked scrub colour (0.05, 0.48, 0.52); patient actors keep the CC0 toigo t-shirt with the closed_casual role palette (patient 0.72, 0.68, 0.55; family/parent 0.42, 0.36, 0.40); lower follows the same palette call. Post-fix the peds cast is pairwise distinct on upper AND lower base colours and the clinician's upper asset differs from the patients'. Footwear assets unchanged. Encounter-distance legibility is graded from the staged lit capture by the orchestrator. Issue #356 (2026-08-13): re-baked with the iris colour case-driven like the garment slot (#180). Pre-fix measured (mpfb-eye-colour/pre-fix.json): one byte-identical iris across the cast (sha256 4659691c7295ad62, 610,817 bytes, 1024^2 RGBA, factor (1,1,1)); baked brown, not greyscale (37% chromatic pixels, hue 34 deg). A licence-clear second asset exists: the official makehuman_system_assets CC0 pack (9 iris colours; every <colour>.mhmat carries the same in-file CC0 header as hm08; pack brown_eye.png byte-identical to the shipped iris; recorded in third-party-asset-licence-ledger.md). materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py now consumes automate_blender.eye_iris_colour(actor_role, phenotype) and resolves the declared colour id to its staged <colour>.mhmat in .openclinxr-local/provider-cache/eyes/makehuman-system-assets/ via the unchanged generic make_material_from_mhmat path (no table copied, no colour invented; baseColorFactor stays (1,1,1) — the texture is the whole appearance). This actor's iris: blue (pack, CC0). Issue #360 (2026-08-13): re-baked with the garment-texture wiring — the materializer now consumes each garment's OWN declared .mhmat diffuseTexture via the generic make_material_from_mhmat path (the #340/#356 eye path): patients' upper toigo t-shirt consumes T-shirt_basic.png and each footwear slot consumes its declared map (flats Shoe.png / mj MJ-shoes3.png / boots boot.png). The #180 role colour is preserved as the exported baseColorFactor (glTF factor x texture; the exporter drops the factor when a texture binds, so it is patched into the GLB post-export). Recorded skips keep flat colours: the scrub's declared Scrub_Shirt.mhmat and the cargo-pants' cargo_pants.mhmat are not staged in the provider cache, and the shipped lower cover shell carries no TEXCOORD_0 — a lower-garment texture is a fitting-pipeline slice, not this material slice.

Issue #335: re-baked with the #334 hide-mask head-joint clip (the t-shirt collar rides high on this body — 0.920 H against its own head joint 0.914 H — so the mask is clipped to the body's own head joint and no longer discards the jaw) and the uniform upper-garment mesh rename to the makeclothes_library_*_mpfb_<ref> convention. Cast into peds_asthma_parent_anxiety_v1 as the nurse; promotionStatus set to promoted_runtime_cast_not_realism_gate_pass (NOT a realism gate pass).

Issue #340: re-baked with the eye material consuming the asset's OWN declared .mhmat — brown.mhmat's diffuseTexture brown_eye.png (CC0, 610,817 bytes, git blob bda1b4b0 == upstream main) bound as glTF baseColorTexture via the generic make_material_from_mhmat path; the flat eye baseColor (#337 white / #338 brown) is gone. Eye geometry (96 verts / 172 tris, eye.L/eye.R weights) unchanged; body macros, hide masks, garment fits, footwear and sole grounding re-run identically. textureMode updated procedural_fallback -> authored_or_baked because the eye channel now carries a baked diffuse texture.

Issue #351 (2026-08-12): re-baked with the wrist/metacarpal limb vocabulary fix in body_param_stage._LIMB_BONE_RE (no-op on the mixamo_unity rail, which has neither bone). The lower cover shell's band selection wrapped the exported A-pose hands — this body's palms are metacarpal-dominant (177+177 outlying verts at |x| up to 0.547 m in the trouser top band) and the regex missed the MPFB standard rig's wrist/metacarpal bones — so the trousers shipped on the hands and the runtime clinical-idle pose wore the shards on the fingers. The widened vocabulary excludes the palm/wrist faces from the shell band; no trouser vertex is hand-weighted. Measured post-fix: lateral ratio 3.745 -> 1.261 (torso half 0.146 m, max |x| 0.184 m), outside-torso tris 306/3092 -> 91/2820 (all hip flare), leg area 5716 cm2, shirt/trouser overlap 17.8 mm unchanged.
